sanskrit_verse:
उत्क्रम्य तु वृतिं यत्र सस्यघातो गवादिभिः।
पालः शास्यो भवेत् तत्र न चेत् शक्त्या निवारयेत्॥
transliteration: utkramya tu vṛtiṃ yatra sasyaghāto gavādibhiḥ | pālaḥ śāsyo bhavet tatra na cet śaktyā nivārayet ||
sph_interpretive_translation: Where agricultural livelihood is abandoned and crops are destroyed by cattle and similar beings, the protector of the region shall be held responsible—if he is capable yet fails to prevent it.
jurisprudential_principles: Authority rests on capacity to act
Causation arises through omission when duty-bound capacity exists
Responsibility aligns with guardianship and protective function
Restoration originates from rectifying failure in role-dharma
Consciousness alignment occurs through assumption of unfulfilled duty
executable_legal_axioms: IF land-use shifts from agriculture AND crop damage occurs due to livestock OR similar agents THEN local guardian authority IS LIABLE
IF guardian has operational capacity AND fails to enforce protection THEN liability IS triggered automatically
LIABILITY RESOLVES through mandatory restoration of productivity AND re-establishment of protective order
RESTORATION includes compensation via labor, resource allocation, or systemic correction protocols
supreme_court_application: In matters involving ecological or agrarian harm caused by negligence of custodial authorities, the Supreme Court must assess not intent but operational capacity. If a custodian had the means to prevent harm yet did not act, judicial intervention shall compel completion of that duty rather than impose punitive measures.
nyaya_and_non_punitive_alignment: Nyaya operates through pramana-based causality: the causal chain includes omission where capability was present. Anupurvasah shows sequence—loss of sustenance follows neglect of duty. Responsibility is proportional to functional capacity. The non-punitive reality rule ensures that corrective action restores balance without inflicting suffering.
restorative_enforcement_protocols: Initiate immediate survey and quantification of agrarian loss
Assign duty completion task to defaulting authority until full restoration
Deploy auxiliary support systems to aid in recovery process
Realign consciousness of responsible party through service-based integration
Verify completion through community validation and renewed productivity metrics
final_declaration: By the Sovereign Authority of Bhagavan Nithyananda Paramashivam, Dharma is executed through conscious responsibility. Justice flows not through punishment but through restoration of integrity. Reality abides in non-retaliation. Consciousness alone is the ultimate adjudicator.
